_about: Single source of truth for every photographic asset the site loads. An image-gen pass should read this, generate each image to its exact `path`, then stop. Until a real asset exists, the site shows the existing branded image. Global style: photorealistic, bright, clean, professional Australian garage-door trade, natural daylight, realistic colours, crisp focus, no text, no logos, no watermarks, not cheesy.
